p1e-03-controller1e-15.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

p1e-04-controller1e-15.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

p1e-04-controller1e-18.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

prepared_weight_certificate.certificate_scope: logical RY/X PREPARE with exact binary64 angles and exact declared controls; accepted Hamiltonian block error requires exact indexed signed-Pauli SELECT with identity padding. Floating nested control decompositions, whole PREPARE-unitary and compiled/synthesized realization are not certified
prepared_weight_certificate.method: directed interval RY/X amplitude propagation; squared probability enclosures; exact-rational coefficient normalization; triangle inequality for norm-one Paulis

source_error_contract.scope: declared logical source for exact real input numbers represented by supplied binary64 coefficients/time, exact named Cliffords, conditional controls and stored rotation angles; exact signed SELECT and interval-enclosed PREPARE weights; polynomial, loading and parameter errors combined by functional calculus and Duhamel. External model-to-input representation, floating nested ControlledGate/MCX realization, compiler/synthesis and physical faults are separate

prepared.instrument_protocol: fresh initialization; complete coherent source; all declared success measurements; reference discard if thermal; full final readout; every rejected trial charged

p1e-03-controller1e-18.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

source_error_contract.scope: exact declared logical H/alpha_exact signal and stored exact angles; this conditioning evaluation includes the supplied error bound, with nested-control realization/compilation/synthesis/instrument faults separate

loading_weight_certificate.certificate_scope: logical RY/X PREPARE with exact binary64 angles and exact declared controls; accepted Hamiltonian block error requires exact indexed signed-Pauli SELECT with identity padding. Floating nested control decompositions, whole PREPARE-unitary and compiled/synthesized realization are not certified
loading_weight_certificate.method: directed interval RY/X amplitude propagation; squared probability enclosures; exact-rational coefficient normalization; triangle inequality for norm-one Paulis

source_error_contract.normalization_shift: F=exp[-beta*(H+alpha_exact I)/2], encoded F/4; positive scalar shift cancels in Gibbs density
source_error_contract.spectral_domain: H/alpha_exact in[-1,1] for exact binary64 input coefficients; alpha_exact is an exact Fraction sum
source_error_contract.implemented_access_contract: The interval weight certificate encloses declared-logical exact RY/controlled-RY probabilities from stored angles and padded labels. Exact signed SELECT makes Bhat Hermitian/involutory in that logical model. Duhamel for shifted positive exponential contractions gives decoded access error<=a_exact*weight_l1. SDK nested-control/MCX realization, flat compiler/synthesis and instruments remain separate.
source_error_contract.phase_arithmetic: stored phases are binary64 and are treated as exact real angles by the coefficient certificate; 2phi and4phi are exact binary powers of two in this bounded domain; nested-decomposition and compiler-created angles are separate
source_error_contract.precompiler_source_scope: rigorous coefficient/weight/parameter bound for exact declared logical Cliffords, controlled gates and stored angles; Bell H/CX gates are exact in this model. This does not certify Qiskit nested controlled-gate/MCX definitions, flat compilation or fault-tolerant synthesis
source_error_contract.coherent_synthesis: not performed; require additional norm bounds for compiler transformations and fault-tolerant synthesis before physical/postselection projections
source_error_contract.instrument_contract: initial resets, success measurements, unconditioned reference discard/reset and final readout are outside the coherent scalar certificate
source_error_contract.input_representation: finite exact binary64 Pauli coefficient list; original physical-model representation error excluded

prepared.target_bound_method: known Bell input and exact trace-zero Pauli list; Jensen Tr exp(-beta H)/d>=1 gives s>=exp(-a_exact)/4; generic exp(-2a_exact)/4 retained separately
prepared.output: one fixed accepted scalar score; state is defined before final data readout
prepared.instrument_protocol: fresh initialization; complete coherent source; all declared success measurements; reference discard if thermal; full final readout; every rejected trial charged

assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

p1e-04-controller1e-15.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

p1e-03-controller1e-18.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

source_error_contract.scope: exact declared logical H/alpha_exact signal and stored exact angles; this conditioning evaluation includes the supplied error bound, with nested-control realization/compilation/synthesis/instrument faults separate

loading_weight_certificate.certificate_scope: logical RY/X PREPARE with exact binary64 angles and exact declared controls; accepted Hamiltonian block error requires exact indexed signed-Pauli SELECT with identity padding. Floating nested control decompositions, whole PREPARE-unitary and compiled/synthesized realization are not certified
loading_weight_certificate.method: directed interval RY/X amplitude propagation; squared probability enclosures; exact-rational coefficient normalization; triangle inequality for norm-one Paulis

source_error_contract.normalization_shift: F=exp[-beta*(H+alpha_exact I)/2], encoded F/4; positive scalar shift cancels in Gibbs density
source_error_contract.spectral_domain: H/alpha_exact in[-1,1] for exact binary64 input coefficients; alpha_exact is an exact Fraction sum
source_error_contract.implemented_access_contract: The interval weight certificate encloses declared-logical exact RY/controlled-RY probabilities from stored angles and padded labels. Exact signed SELECT makes Bhat Hermitian/involutory in that logical model. Duhamel for shifted positive exponential contractions gives decoded access error<=a_exact*weight_l1. SDK nested-control/MCX realization, flat compiler/synthesis and instruments remain separate.
source_error_contract.phase_arithmetic: stored phases are binary64 and are treated as exact real angles by the coefficient certificate; 2phi and4phi are exact binary powers of two in this bounded domain; nested-decomposition and compiler-created angles are separate
source_error_contract.precompiler_source_scope: rigorous coefficient/weight/parameter bound for exact declared logical Cliffords, controlled gates and stored angles; Bell H/CX gates are exact in this model. This does not certify Qiskit nested controlled-gate/MCX definitions, flat compilation or fault-tolerant synthesis
source_error_contract.coherent_synthesis: not performed; require additional norm bounds for compiler transformations and fault-tolerant synthesis before physical/postselection projections
source_error_contract.instrument_contract: initial resets, success measurements, unconditioned reference discard/reset and final readout are outside the coherent scalar certificate
source_error_contract.input_representation: finite exact binary64 Pauli coefficient list; original physical-model representation error excluded

measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

source_error_contract.scope: exact declared logical H/alpha_exact signal and stored exact angles; this conditioning evaluation includes the supplied error bound, with nested-control realization/compilation/synthesis/instrument faults separate

loading_weight_certificate.certificate_scope: logical RY/X PREPARE with exact binary64 angles and exact declared controls; accepted Hamiltonian block error requires exact indexed signed-Pauli SELECT with identity padding. Floating nested control decompositions, whole PREPARE-unitary and compiled/synthesized realization are not certified
loading_weight_certificate.method: directed interval RY/X amplitude propagation; squared probability enclosures; exact-rational coefficient normalization; triangle inequality for norm-one Paulis

source_error_contract.normalization_shift: F=exp[-beta*(H+alpha_exact I)/2], encoded F/4; positive scalar shift cancels in Gibbs density
source_error_contract.spectral_domain: H/alpha_exact in[-1,1] for exact binary64 input coefficients; alpha_exact is an exact Fraction sum
source_error_contract.implemented_access_contract: The interval weight certificate encloses declared-logical exact RY/controlled-RY probabilities from stored angles and padded labels. Exact signed SELECT makes Bhat Hermitian/involutory in that logical model. Duhamel for shifted positive exponential contractions gives decoded access error<=a_exact*weight_l1. SDK nested-control/MCX realization, flat compiler/synthesis and instruments remain separate.
source_error_contract.phase_arithmetic: stored phases are binary64 and are treated as exact real angles by the coefficient certificate; 2phi and4phi are exact binary powers of two in this bounded domain; nested-decomposition and compiler-created angles are separate
source_error_contract.precompiler_source_scope: rigorous coefficient/weight/parameter bound for exact declared logical Cliffords, controlled gates and stored angles; Bell H/CX gates are exact in this model. This does not certify Qiskit nested controlled-gate/MCX definitions, flat compilation or fault-tolerant synthesis
source_error_contract.coherent_synthesis: not performed; require additional norm bounds for compiler transformations and fault-tolerant synthesis before physical/postselection projections
source_error_contract.instrument_contract: initial resets, success measurements, unconditioned reference discard/reset and final readout are outside the coherent scalar certificate
source_error_contract.input_representation: finite exact binary64 Pauli coefficient list; original physical-model representation error excluded

prepared.score_bit_order: first outcome clbit is least significant
prepared.target_bound_method: known Bell input and exact trace-zero Pauli list; Jensen Tr exp(-beta H)/d>=1 gives s>=exp(-a_exact)/4; generic exp(-2a_exact)/4 retained separately
prepared.output: one fixed accepted scalar score; state is defined before final data readout
prepared.instrument_protocol: fresh initialization; complete coherent source; all declared success measurements; reference discard if thermal; full final readout; every rejected trial charged

p1e-03-controller1e-18.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration

p1e-04-controller1e-18.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled

controller_model_diagnostic.scope: additive contribution within the declared engineering model; not a hardware fault lower bound or calibration
